variants.text: Adult male with an oblong face, short dark textured hair, and light stubble.
Adult male with an oblong face, prominent bone structure, short dark textured hair, and light stubble on the jaw and chin.

Adult male, oblong face, prominent bone structure, moderate soft tissue, straight hairline with temporal recession, high forehead. Thick, medium-length, soft-arched eyebrows with lateral thinning. Almond-shaped eyes, slight upward canthal tilt, double upper-lid crease. Straight nasal dorsum, rounded tip. Balanced lips, short philtrum, teeth visible at rest. Average-sized ears, free lobes. Short dark textured hairstyle, light stubble on jaw and chin.
A man with an oblong face, short dark textured hair, and some light stubble on his jaw and chin. He has a prominent bone structure, thick eyebrows, and is smiling.
